request.message:
Update this standing weekly production digest to Week 7. This is the same document every week - edit it in place. Make exactly the changes below and nothing else. STEP 1 - STATUS LINE. The bold status line directly under the document title must read exactly: Week 7 · 2026-02-16 to 2026-02-22 · Phase: Vertical Slice Leave the smaller grey line beneath it unchanged. STEP 2 - ARCHIVE. The 'Archive' table's data rows must end up being EXACTLY these 6 rows, in exactly this order, top to bottom. Keep the table's header row and all of its formatting. Cells shown in quotes are literal - copy them exactly. Cells shown in angle brackets are for you to write. The rows, top to bottom, must be exactly: 'Week 6', 'Week 5', 'Week 4', 'Week 3', 'Week 2', 'Week 1'. Row 'Week 6' is NEW. Its Dates cell is '2026-02-09 to 2026-02-15'. Its Shipped cell is your own summary, at most 20 words, of the bullets currently under 'What changed'. Its Risks carried cell is your own summary, at most 15 words, of the rows currently in the 'What is at risk' table. Every other row keeps its existing cell contents exactly as they are - do not rewrite, reword or re-summarise them. STEP 3 - 'What changed'. Replace the ENTIRE
    element in that section with exactly this HTML, character for character:
    • Grapple cooldown retuned from 8s to 5s after playtest data
    • Cinematic camera rig handed to the animation team
    • Localisation pipeline stubbed for 6 languages
    • Vertical slice level greyboxed and playable start to finish
    STEP 4 - 'What is at risk' table. Replace the ENTIRE contents of that table's with exactly these 3 rows, character for character. Keep the header row exactly as it is: Save-game format still unversionedDev H.EngineeringMediumimprovingMatchmaking backend untested above 5k CCUYuki T.BackendHighsteadySecond combat designer starts lateMarcus O.ProductionMediumsteady (Context only, do not put this in the document: risks closed this week and therefore absent from the rows above: Boss encounter difficulty untuned for controller.) STEP 5 - 'What is next'. Replace the ENTIRE
      element in that section with exactly this HTML, character for character:
      • Instrument the traversal funnel
      • Close the audio licence
      • Get the slice in front of the publisher
      REPLACEMENT MEANS REPLACEMENT: where this instruction lists what a section must contain, the section must end up containing exactly that and nothing else. Delete what is not on the list rather than keeping it alongside. Preserve all existing formatting exactly: the document title, every section heading, table borders, header-row shading, alternating row colours, fonts, font sizes and colours. Do not restyle anything. Do not add, remove or rename any heading. Do not reorder the sections. Copy every quoted or listed value character for character. Do not add a full stop to a bullet that has none, and do not reword anything. STRUCTURAL RULE: both tables must remain elements with their header rows intact. Never replace a table with a single row, a div or a list. Never drop a table's header row.
request.document_html:
Nebula Drift - Weekly Production Digest

Week 6 · 2026-02-09 to 2026-02-15 · Phase: Pre-production
Vantage Nine Studios · internal · standing document, edited in place every Monday

What changed

  • Engine upgrade to 5.4 merged; build times down 31%
  • Art style exploration narrowed to two directions
  • Nav-mesh generation for the Drift Belt sector
  • First pass on the Salvage economy spreadsheet

What is at risk

RiskOwnerArea SeverityTrend
Boss encounter difficulty untuned for controllerAna F.DesignLowsteady
Save-game format still unversionedDev H.EngineeringLowsteady

What is next

  • Lock the art direction to one of the two candidates
  • Scope the vertical slice level list
  • Stand up the automated build farm

Archive

Newest first. Detail rows older than 8 weeks are folded into a single rolled-up row so this section stays readable at 52 weeks.

WeekDates ShippedRisks carried
Week 52026-02-02 to 2026-02-08Engine 5.4 merged, build times down 31%, art narrowed, Drift Belt nav-mesh built, Salvage spreadsheet startedController boss tuning and save-game versioning
Week 42026-01-26 to 2026-02-01Nav-mesh generation for the Drift Belt sector and first pass on the Salvage economy spreadsheet.Controller boss tuning and outsourced art delays.
Week 32026-01-19 to 2026-01-25Nav-mesh generation and Salvage economy spreadsheet first pass.Controller boss tuning and outsourced art delay.
Week 22026-01-12 to 2026-01-18Hired combat designer, migrated Perforce to Git LFS, and completed end-to-end grapple traversal prototype.Save-game unversioned, controller boss encounter difficulty, and outsourced character art delivery delay.
Week 12026-01-05 to 2026-01-11Narrowed art style to two directions and completed nav-mesh generation for Drift Belt sector.Unversioned save format, boss encounter difficulty issues, and character art delivery delay.
